criterion_bindings.exemption: Canonical discovery and cleanup eligibility are operation properties, not one query-corpus case. TestQ10RebuildsCommittedOutcomeWithoutLiveWorkOrPublicationFlag (internal/store/knowledge_index_test.go) is a candidate discovery witness; Q10-not-compacted, executed by TestAcceptedQ1ToQ10Corpus (internal/store/query_corpus_test.go), covers work with no verified note. Integrated coverage remains unmeasured.

Orphan recovery is an operation property below scenario grain. The guarantee is proved by TestFindVerifiedWorkNoteDiscoversOrphansWithoutCreatingNotes (internal/store/knowledge_index_test.go) and TestDispatchReconcileLinksVerifiedOrphanWithoutSecondNote (internal/agent/mutation_dispatch_test.go).

Git-proof verification is an operation property. The guarantee is proved by TestVerifyCommittedNoteRejectsHashMismatchAndSymlink and TestVerifyCommittedNoteRejectsUnsafeAndNonBlobPaths (internal/store/knowledge_index_test.go).
Ambiguous-claim detection is a rebuild property. The guarantee is proved by TestParseKnowledgeNoteRejectsAmbiguousAndMalformedCriticalMetadata (internal/store/knowledge_index_test.go).

summary: Verifies canonical Git note identity and publication recovery; canonical discovery is independent of settled linkage and does not itself authorize terminal cleanup.
title: Canonical Git note placement
